records.context: For one measure, the per-frame effects (:func:`frame_effects`) up to the division (``rel_t <= 0``) are read from the division backwards. The direction is the sign of ``g`` at the last frame before division. A frame is significant when its interval excludes 0 in that direction. When the last frame is not significant there is no onset (NaN, with the direction still given); otherwise the onset is the earliest ``rel_t`` of the unbroken significant run that ends at the division.
records.label: spacr.division_analysis.onset_times#1
records.source: For one measure, the per-frame effects (:func:`frame_effects`) up to the division (``rel_t <= 0``) are read from the division backwards. When the last frame is not significant there is no onset (NaN, with the direction still given); otherwise the onset is the earliest ``rel_t`` of the unbroken significant run that ends at the division.
records.translation: Para uma medida, os efeitos por quadro (:func:`frame_effects`) até a divisão (``rel_t <= 0``) são lidos da divisão para trás. A direção é o sinal de ``g`` no último quadro antes da divisão. Um quadro é significativo quando o seu intervalo exclui 0 nessa direção. Quando o último quadro não é significativo, não há início (NaN, com a direção ainda indicada); caso contrário, o início é o ``rel_t`` mais precoce da sequência significativa ininterrupta que termina na divisão.

records.context: The cell level follows brieflow. Brieflow (Di Bernardo et al., Nat Commun 2026, doi:10.1038/s41467-026-73643-7; cheeseman-lab/brieflow, MIT licence) reduces a gene as the median of all of its cells (``lib.aggregate.aggregate`` by ``gene_symbol_0``). A guide with many cells then weighs more than one with few, where the guide level gives every guide one vote. On plate A of Funk et al. 2022 the cell level raised mean retrieval mAP from 0.0602 to 0.0639 in TVN space.
records.label: spacr.gene_measurement_compare.aggregate_genes#9
records.source: THE CELL LEVEL FOLLOWS BRIEFLOW. Brieflow (Di Bernardo et al., Nat Commun 2026, doi:10.1038/s41467-026-73643-7; cheeseman-lab/brieflow, MIT licence) reduces a gene as the median of all of its cells (``lib.aggregate.aggregate`` by ``gene_symbol_0``). A guide with many cells then weighs more than one with few, where the guide level gives every guide one vote. On plate A of Funk et al. 2022 the cell level raised mean retrieval mAP from 0.0602 to 0.0639 in TVN space.
records.translation: O NÍVEL DE CÉLULAS SEGUE O BRIEFLOW. O Brieflow (Di Bernardo et al., Nat Commun 2026, doi:10.1038/s41467-026-73643-7; cheeseman-lab/brieflow, licença MIT) reduz um gene como a mediana de todas as suas células (``lib.aggregate.aggregate`` por ``gene_symbol_0``). Uma guia com muitas células pesa então mais do que uma com poucas, enquanto o nível de guias dá um voto a cada guia. Na placa A de Funk et al. 2022, o nível de células elevou o mAP médio de recuperação de 0.0602 para 0.0639 no espaço TVN.

records.label: spacr.gene_measurement_compare.contrastive_weighting#10

records.context: The gene rows are embedded (standardised, PCA 99 %) and the guide rows put in the same space. The noise covariance is the Ledoit-Wolf covariance (Ledoit & Wolf 2004) of the centred non-targeting guide rows, divided by ``kbar``, the mean number of guides per targeting gene, since a gene profile pools that many guides. The generalised eigenproblem ``Sigma_genes v = lambda Sigma_noise v`` gives directions ordered by signal over noise; each is weighted by ``max((lambda - 1) / lambda, 0)``, a Wiener weight. This is a contrastive eigenproblem in the spirit of contrastive PCA (Abid et al. 2018).
records.label: spacr.gene_measurement_compare.contrastive_weighting#11
records.source: The gene rows are embedded (standardised, PCA 99 %) and the guide rows put in the same space. The noise covariance is the Ledoit-Wolf covariance (Ledoit & Wolf 2004) of the centred non-targeting guide rows, divided by ``kbar``, the mean number of guides per targeting gene, since a gene profile pools that many guides. The generalised eigenproblem ``Sigma_genes v = lambda Sigma_noise v`` gives directions ordered by signal over noise; each is weighted by ``max((lambda - 1) / lambda, 0)``, a Wiener weight. This is a contrastive eigenproblem in the spirit of contrastive PCA (Abid et al. 2018).
records.translation: As linhas de genes são incorporadas (padronizadas, PCA 99 %) e as linhas de guias colocadas no mesmo espaço. A covariância do ruído é a covariância de Ledoit-Wolf (Ledoit & Wolf 2004) das linhas centradas das guias não direcionadas, dividida por ``kbar``, o número médio de guias por gene direcionado, já que um perfil de gene agrupa esse número de guias. O problema de autovalores generalizado ``Sigma_genes v = lambda Sigma_noise v`` dá direções ordenadas por sinal sobre ruído; cada uma é ponderada por ``max((lambda - 1) / lambda, 0)``, um peso de Wiener. Este é um problema de autovalores contrastivo no espírito da PCA contrastiva (Abid et al. 2018).

records.context: It refuses a degenerate space. On profiles already shrunk toward the controls (:func:`shrink_gene_profiles`) no direction rises above the noise, every weight is 0 and every row the zero vector; a retrieval score then ranks ties first and reports AP = 1. Do not stack the two.

Em perfis já encolhidos em direção aos controles (:func:`shrink_gene_profiles`), nenhuma direção se eleva acima do ruído, todos os pesos são 0 e todas as linhas são o vetor zero; uma pontuação de recuperação então classifica os empates primeiro e relata AP = 1. records.context: The guide model is jacks' rank-1 model (Allen et al. 2019, Genome Res, doi:10.1101/gr.238923.118), with the profile features in the role of JACKS' screening experiments: each guide row is ``x_g = e_g m + noise``, the noise variance proportional to ``1 / n_cells(g)``. Starting from ``e = 1``, ``m = sum w e x / sum w e^2`` (``w`` the cell counts) and ``e = clip(<x, m> / <m, m>, 0, emax)`` alternate, ``e`` rescaled so its maximum is 1, for at most ``iters`` rounds or until ``e`` changes by less than 1e-6. The efficacy-weighted profile ``M`` is then blended with the all-cell gene profile ``Z`` as unit vectors. A gene row without guide rows keeps ``Z``. The method uses no reference labels.
records.label: spacr.gene_measurement_compare.guide_efficacy_profiles#8
records.source: THE GUIDE MODEL IS JACKS' RANK-1 MODEL (Allen et al. 2019, Genome Res, doi:10.1101/gr.238923.118), with the profile features in the role of JACKS' screens: each guide row is ``x_g = e_g m + noise``, the noise variance proportional to ``1 / n_cells(g)``. Starting from ``e = 1``, ``m = sum w e x / sum w e^2`` (``w`` the cell counts) and ``e = clip(<x, m> / <m, m>, 0, emax)`` alternate, ``e`` rescaled so its maximum is 1, for at most ``iters`` rounds or until ``e`` changes by less than 1e-6. The efficacy-weighted profile ``M`` is then blended with the all-cell gene profile ``Z`` as unit vectors. A gene row without guide rows keeps ``Z``. The method uses no reference labels.
records.translation: O MODELO DE GUIAS É O MODELO DE POSTO 1 DO JACKS (Allen et al. 2019, Genome Res, doi:10.1101/gr.238923.118), com as variáveis do perfil no papel das triagens do JACKS: cada linha de guia é ``x_g = e_g m + noise``, com a variância do ruído proporcional a ``1 / n_cells(g)``. Partindo de ``e = 1``, alternam-se ``m = sum w e x / sum w e^2`` (``w`` as contagens de células) e ``e = clip(<x, m> / <m, m>, 0, emax)``, com ``e`` reescalado para que o seu máximo seja 1, por no máximo ``iters`` rodadas ou até que ``e`` mude menos de 1e-6. O perfil ponderado pela eficácia ``M`` é então combinado com o perfil do gene de todas as células ``Z`` como vetores unitários. Uma linha de gene sem linhas de guias mantém ``Z``. O método não usa rótulos de referência.

records.context: The guides are embedded as the benchmark embeds them (standardised, PCA 99 %, fitted on the guides) and scaled to unit length; ``s(A, B)`` is the mean of the ``k_A x k_B`` guide-guide cosines. The null of a pair is ``null_size`` similarities between two random guide sets of the same sizes, each guide from a distinct random targeting gene, so a P value asks whether two genes agree more than random guides do. Benjamini- Hochberg gives ``q`` across all pairs. The pseudo-genes, paired with every tested gene, should give uniform P values; the share under 0.05 is the calibration control. Non-targeting guide sets give a second null, reported for comparison. Without reference sets this does not annotate pairs with CORUM or STRING; :mod:`spacr.ops_clusters` scores those.

records.source: The guides are embedded as the benchmark embeds them (standardised, PCA 99 %, fitted on the guides) and scaled to unit length; ``s(A, B)`` is the mean of the ``k_A x k_B`` guide-guide cosines. The null of a pair is ``null_size`` similarities between two random guide sets of the same sizes, each guide from a distinct random targeting gene, so a P value asks whether two genes agree more than random guides do. Benjamini- Hochberg gives ``q`` across all pairs. The pseudo-genes, paired with every tested gene, should give uniform P values; the share under 0.05 is the calibration control. Non-targeting guide sets give a second null, reported for comparison. Without reference sets this does not annotate pairs with CORUM or STRING; :mod:`spacr.ops_clusters` scores those.
records.translation: As guias são incorporadas como o benchmark as incorpora (padronizadas, PCA 99 %, ajustada nas guias) e escaladas para comprimento unitário; ``s(A, B)`` é a média dos ``k_A x k_B`` cossenos guia-guia. O nulo de um par são ``null_size`` similaridades entre dois conjuntos aleatórios de guias dos mesmos tamanhos, cada guia de um gene direcionado aleatório distinto, de modo que um valor P pergunta se dois genes concordam mais do que guias aleatórias. Benjamini- Hochberg dá ``q`` entre todos os pares. Os pseudogenes, pareados com cada gene testado, devem dar valores P uniformes; a fração abaixo de 0.05 é o controle de calibração. Conjuntos de guias não direcionadas dão um segundo nulo, relatado para comparação. Sem conjuntos de referência, isto não anota pares com CORUM ou STRING; :mod:`spacr.ops_clusters` os pontua.

records.context: A receiver is exposed to gene X when a genotyped neighbour carries X; a neighbour with the receiver's own guide never counts, so clone sisters are not exposures, and the reference is exposure to a control neighbour. Receiver features are its TVN components minus its own gene's mean in the microplate sample position, residualised within microscope field of view on local density and radial position (Frisch-Waugh-Lovell). The statistic is ``T = sum_d d^2 / (v_X + v_ref)``, ``d`` the exposed-minus-reference mean and ``v`` its microscope field of view-clustered variance. Nulls: genotypes shuffled within each microscope field of view, and a clone-preserving shuffle that moves whole same-guide clusters; the control pseudo-genes are exposures too. ``p`` is empirical against the pooled null genes of the same exposure-count quintile, ``q`` Benjamini-Hochberg across genes.
records.label: spacr.gene_measurement_compare.neighbour_effects#10
records.source: A receiver is exposed to gene X when a genotyped neighbour carries X; a neighbour with the receiver's own guide never counts, so clone sisters are not exposures, and the reference is exposure to a control neighbour. Receiver features are its TVN components minus its own gene's mean in the well, residualised within field on local density and radial position (Frisch-Waugh-Lovell). The statistic is ``T = sum_d d^2 / (v_X + v_ref)``, ``d`` the exposed-minus-reference mean and ``v`` its field-clustered variance. Nulls: genotypes shuffled within each field, and a clone-preserving shuffle that moves whole same-guide clusters; the control pseudo-genes are exposures too. ``p`` is empirical against the pooled null genes of the same exposure-count quintile, ``q`` Benjamini-Hochberg across genes.
records.translation: Um receptor está exposto ao gene X quando um vizinho genotipado porta X; um vizinho com a própria guia do receptor nunca conta, de modo que irmãs clonais não são exposições, e a referência é a exposição a um vizinho de controle. As variáveis do receptor são os seus componentes TVN menos a média do seu próprio gene no poço, residualizados dentro do campo quanto à densidade local e à posição radial (Frisch-Waugh-Lovell). A estatística é ``T = sum_d d^2 / (v_X + v_ref)``, sendo ``d`` a média exposta menos a de referência e ``v`` a sua variância agrupada por campo. Nulos: genótipos embaralhados dentro de cada campo, e um embaralhamento que preserva clones e move agrupamentos inteiros da mesma guia; os pseudogenes de controle também são exposições. ``p`` é empírico contra os genes nulos agrupados do mesmo quintil de contagem de exposição, ``q`` Benjamini-Hochberg entre genes.

records.context: Every cell is scored by a model that never saw its field. Fields go to folds by name (:func:`field_folds`). For each fold an L2 logistic regression (balanced classes) is trained on the gene's and the controls' cells of the other folds, and the held-out gene cells are placed on the held-out control cells: ``u`` is their control percentile, uniform without an effect, and ``z`` their control z score. The penetrance is Storey's estimator on ``u`` (:func:`storey_penetrance`) with a 95 % interval from resampling whole fields; escapers are tested on ``z`` (:func:`escaper_statistics`), and a call stands only if none of ``simulations`` unimodal simulations of the fitted shift makes it. Guides are compared by the share of their cells above half the responder mode (chi-square). CONTROLS: the non-targeting pseudo-genes (:func:`nt_row_names`) scored against the pool without their own cells, which should show no penetrance; and ``shuffled`` genes whose gene and control labels are permuted, whose penetrance should fall to the real cells' share times the gene's penetrance.
records.label: spacr.gene_measurement_compare.penetrance_tests#20
records.source: EVERY CELL IS SCORED BY A MODEL THAT NEVER SAW ITS FIELD. Fields go to folds by name (:func:`field_folds`). For each fold an L2 logistic regression (balanced classes) is trained on the gene's and the controls' cells of the other folds, and the held-out gene cells are placed on the held-out control cells: ``u`` is their control percentile, uniform without an effect, and ``z`` their control z score. The penetrance is Storey's estimator on ``u`` (:func:`storey_penetrance`) with a 95 % interval from resampling whole fields; escapers are tested on ``z`` (:func:`escaper_statistics`), and a call stands only if none of ``simulations`` unimodal simulations of the fitted shift makes it. Guides are compared by the share of their cells above half the responder mode (chi-square). CONTROLS: the non-targeting pseudo-genes (:func:`nt_row_names`) scored against the pool without their own cells, which should show no penetrance; and ``shuffled`` genes whose gene and control labels are permuted, whose penetrance should fall to the real cells' share times the gene's penetrance.
records.translation: CADA CÉLULA É PONTUADA POR UM MODELO QUE NUNCA VIU O SEU CAMPO. Os campos vão para partições pelo nome (:func:`field_folds`). Para cada partição, uma regressão logística L2 (classes balanceadas) é treinada com as células do gene e dos controles das outras partições, e as células retidas do gene são posicionadas sobre as células de controle retidas: ``u`` é o seu percentil entre os controles, uniforme sem efeito, e ``z`` o seu escore z em relação aos controles. A penetrância é o estimador de Storey sobre ``u`` (:func:`storey_penetrance`) com um intervalo de 95 % obtido reamostrando campos inteiros; os escapes são testados sobre ``z`` (:func:`escaper_statistics`), e uma chamada só se mantém se nenhuma das ``simulations`` simulações unimodais do deslocamento ajustado a produz. As guias são comparadas pela fração das suas células acima da metade do modo respondedor (qui-quadrado). CONTROLES: os pseudogenes não direcionados (:func:`nt_row_names`) pontuados contra o conjunto sem as suas próprias células, que não devem mostrar penetrância; e genes ``shuffled`` cujos rótulos de gene e de controle são permutados, cuja penetrância deve cair para a fração de células reais vezes a penetrância do gene.

records.context: Profiles are ``pooled`` (every cell, centred on its well's controls) and each phase (that phase's cells, centred on the well's controls of the same phase); a guide is the median of its cells, with at least three. A gene's statistic is ``T = sum_d M_d^2 / V_d`` over the dimensions, ``M`` the mean of its guides and ``V_d = (1/K^2) sum_j (a_d + b_d / n_j)``, the noise fitted on the control guides of the first half of the pseudo-genes; the second half is held out. ``T`` is referred to a scaled chi-square matched to the null sets' mean and variance. The targeting null is the main one: every targeting guide cuts DNA, control guides do not, so against controls almost every gene differs pooled. The interaction profiles test a phase against the gene's other cells. A gene is phase-specific when its phase ``q < 0.1`` (Benjamini-Hochberg) and its pooled ``q >= 0.1``.
records.label: spacr.gene_measurement_compare.phase_tests#13
records.source: Profiles are ``pooled`` (every cell, centred on its well's controls) and each phase (that phase's cells, centred on the well's controls of the same phase); a guide is the median of its cells, with at least three. A gene's statistic is ``T = sum_d M_d^2 / V_d`` over the dimensions, ``M`` the mean of its guides and ``V_d = (1/K^2) sum_j (a_d + b_d / n_j)``, the noise fitted on the control guides of the first half of the pseudo-genes; the second half is held out. ``T`` is referred to a scaled chi-square matched to the null sets' mean and variance. The targeting null is the main one: every targeting guide cuts DNA, control guides do not, so against controls almost every gene differs pooled. The interaction profiles test a phase against the gene's other cells. A gene is phase-specific when its phase ``q < 0.1`` (Benjamini-Hochberg) and its pooled ``q >= 0.1``.
records.translation: Os perfis são ``pooled`` (todas as células, centradas nos controles do seu poço) e cada fase (as células dessa fase, centradas nos controles do poço da mesma fase); uma guia é a mediana das suas células, com pelo menos três. A estatística de um gene é ``T = sum_d M_d^2 / V_d`` sobre as dimensões, sendo ``M`` a média das suas guias e ``V_d = (1/K^2) sum_j (a_d + b_d / n_j)`` o ruído ajustado nas guias de controle da primeira metade dos pseudogenes; a segunda metade é retida. ``T`` é referido a um qui-quadrado escalado ajustado à média e à variância dos conjuntos nulos. O nulo direcionado é o principal: toda guia direcionada corta o DNA, as guias de controle não, então contra controles quase todo gene difere de forma agrupada. Os perfis de interação testam uma fase contra as outras células do gene. Um gene é específico de fase quando o ``q < 0.1`` da sua fase (Benjamini-Hochberg) e o seu ``q >= 0.1`` agrupado.

records.context: Per feature ``d``, a guide's noise is the between-guide variance ``a_d`` of the non-targeting guides plus the sampling variance of a median of ``n`` cells, ``(pi / 2) v_d / n`` with ``v_d = 1``. For each gene that noise, averaged over its guides, is pooled with the gene's own between-guide variance (``K - 1`` degrees of freedom against ``prior_df``), so a gene whose guides disagree is shrunk more. The prior signal variance ``tau2_d`` comes from the moments of the targeting genes, and the gene's mean guide profile, centred on the non-targeting guides, is multiplied by ``tau2 / (tau2 + V / K)``. This is empirical-Bayes variance moderation (Smyth 2004) followed by a James-Stein-type shrinkage. Do not stack it with :func:`contrastive_weighting`, which then has no direction left.
records.label: spacr.gene_measurement_compare.shrink_gene_profiles#7
records.source: Per feature ``d``, a guide's noise is the between-guide variance ``a_d`` of the non-targeting guides plus the sampling variance of a median of ``n`` cells, ``(pi / 2) v_d / n`` with ``v_d = 1``. For each gene that noise, averaged over its guides, is pooled with the gene's own between-guide variance (``K - 1`` degrees of freedom against ``prior_df``), so a gene whose guides disagree is shrunk more. The prior signal variance ``tau2_d`` comes from the moments of the targeting genes, and the gene's mean guide profile, centred on the non-targeting guides, is multiplied by ``tau2 / (tau2 + V / K)``. This is empirical-Bayes variance moderation (Smyth 2004) followed by a James-Stein-type shrinkage. Do not stack it with :func:`contrastive_weighting`, which then has no direction left.
records.translation: Por variável ``d``, o ruído de uma guia é a variância entre guias ``a_d`` das guias não direcionadas mais a variância amostral de uma mediana de ``n`` células, ``(pi / 2) v_d / n`` com ``v_d = 1``. Para cada gene, esse ruído, com média sobre as suas guias, é combinado com a própria variância entre guias do gene (``K - 1`` graus de liberdade contra ``prior_df``), de modo que um gene cujas guias discordam é mais encolhido. A variância a priori do sinal ``tau2_d`` vem dos momentos dos genes direcionados, e o perfil médio das guias do gene, centrado nas guias não direcionadas, é multiplicado por ``tau2 / (tau2 + V / K)``. Isto é moderação de variância por Bayes empírico (Smyth 2004) seguida de um encolhimento do tipo James-Stein. Não o empilhe com :func:`contrastive_weighting`, que então não teria nenhuma direção restante.

records.context: ``stack`` is a merged array ``[..., c]`` with the image data channels and, at image layers 3, 4 and 5, the cell (territory), nucleus and parasite masks. Parasites under ``translocation_min_pathogen_size`` pixels are dropped; vacuoles are :func:`vacuoles_from_parasites` with ``vacuole_gap_px``; parasites and vacuoles go to the cell holding most of their pixels. Nucleus pixels within ``translocation_exclude_px`` of a parasite pixel are excluded from the corrected readout; the microscope field of view background is the median effector signal outside every cell and parasite (the ``translocation_background_fallback_percentile`` of the microscope field of view when fewer than ``translocation_background_min_px`` such pixels).
records.label: spacr.host_pathogen.translocation_cells#1
records.source: ``stack`` is a merged array ``[..., c]`` with the image channels and, at planes 3, 4 and 5, the cell (territory), nucleus and parasite masks. Parasites under ``translocation_min_pathogen_size`` pixels are dropped; vacuoles are :func:`vacuoles_from_parasites` with ``vacuole_gap_px``; parasites and vacuoles go to the cell holding most of their pixels. Nucleus pixels within ``translocation_exclude_px`` of a parasite pixel are excluded from the corrected readout; the field background is the median effector signal outside every cell and parasite (the ``translocation_background_fallback_percentile`` of the field when fewer than ``translocation_background_min_px`` such pixels).
records.translation: ``stack`` é um array mesclado ``[..., c]`` com os canais da imagem e, nos planos 3, 4 e 5, as máscaras de célula (território), núcleo e parasita. Parasitas com menos de ``translocation_min_pathogen_size`` pixels são descartados; os vacúolos são :func:`vacuoles_from_parasites` com ``vacuole_gap_px``; parasitas e vacúolos vão para a célula que contém a maior parte dos seus pixels. Pixels do núcleo dentro de ``translocation_exclude_px`` de um pixel de parasita são excluídos da leitura corrigida; o fundo do campo é a mediana do sinal do efetor fora de todas as células e parasitas (o ``translocation_background_fallback_percentile`` do campo quando há menos de ``translocation_background_min_px`` desses pixels).

records.context: Effector translocation against vacuoles per cell, with its controls.
records.label: spacr.host_pathogen.translocation_summary#0
records.source: Effector translocation against vacuoles per cell, with its controls.
records.translation: Translocação do efetor contra vacúolos por célula, com os seus controles.

records.context: Every cell gets its group from ``translocation_groups`` (by microplate sample position row, or by microplate sample position from a laboratory microplate map) and two readouts: raw (``ha_total_nucleus``) and corrected (``(ha_mean_nucleus_excl - bg_ha) x nucleus_area``). Cells with nuclei under ``translocation_min_nucleus_size`` are left out. Curves bin cells by k = vacuoles per cell up to ``translocation_kmax`` and divide by the k = 0 cells of the same group; per-microplate sample position ratios use microplate sample positions with ``translocation_min_cells_per_bin`` cells in the bin. The controls are the k = 0 reference, the ``translocation_null_percentile`` threshold of the corrected mean in k = 0 cells (% positive nuclei per k and per microplate sample position), the within-field shuffle of k (``translocation_shuffle_n`` times, seed ``translocation_seed``, group by group, raw then corrected), the DNA control, nucleus area and the excluded fraction.
records.label: spacr.host_pathogen.translocation_summary#1
records.source: Every cell gets its group from ``translocation_groups`` (by well row, or by well from a plate map) and two readouts: raw (``ha_total_nucleus``) and corrected (``(ha_mean_nucleus_excl - bg_ha) x nucleus_area``). Cells with nuclei under ``translocation_min_nucleus_size`` are left out. Curves bin cells by k = vacuoles per cell up to ``translocation_kmax`` and divide by the k = 0 cells of the same group; per-well ratios use wells with ``translocation_min_cells_per_bin`` cells in the bin. The controls are the k = 0 reference, the ``translocation_null_percentile`` threshold of the corrected mean in k = 0 cells (% positive nuclei per k and per well), the within-field shuffle of k (``translocation_shuffle_n`` times, seed ``translocation_seed``, group by group, raw then corrected), the DNA control, nucleus area and the excluded fraction.
records.translation: Cada célula recebe o seu grupo de ``translocation_groups`` (por linha de poços, ou por poço a partir de um mapa da placa) e duas leituras: bruta (``ha_total_nucleus``) e corrigida (``(ha_mean_nucleus_excl - bg_ha) x nucleus_area``). Células com núcleos abaixo de ``translocation_min_nucleus_size`` são deixadas de fora. As curvas agrupam as células por k = vacúolos por célula até ``translocation_kmax`` e dividem pelas células com k = 0 do mesmo grupo; as razões por poço usam poços com ``translocation_min_cells_per_bin`` células na faixa. Os controles são a referência k = 0, o limiar ``translocation_null_percentile`` da média corrigida nas células com k = 0 (% de núcleos positivos por k e por poço), o embaralhamento de k dentro do campo (``translocation_shuffle_n`` vezes, semente ``translocation_seed``, grupo a grupo, bruta e depois corrigida), o controle de DNA, a área do núcleo e a fração excluída.

records.context: Every stratum (each combination of the ``strata`` structured-data names) contributes up to ``ceil(n / number of strata)`` objects drawn with ``seed``; when that falls short of ``n`` the rest is drawn from what is left, spread over the first structured-data name with ``seed + 1``. The result is shuffled with ``seed + 2`` and cut to ``n``. A stratum structured-data name ``column:q`` bins the column into q quantiles by rank within each value of the first structured-data name.
records.label: spacr.ml.annotation_sample#1
records.source: Every stratum (each combination of the ``strata`` keys) contributes up to ``ceil(n / number of strata)`` objects drawn with ``seed``; when that falls short of ``n`` the rest is drawn from what is left, spread over the first key with ``seed + 1``. The result is shuffled with ``seed + 2`` and cut to ``n``. A stratum key ``column:q`` bins the column into q quantiles by rank within each value of the first key.
records.translation: Cada estrato (cada combinação das chaves de ``strata``) contribui com até ``ceil(n / number of strata)`` objetos sorteados com ``seed``; quando isso não chega a ``n``, o restante é sorteado do que sobra, distribuído pela primeira chave com ``seed + 1``. O resultado é embaralhado com ``seed + 2`` e cortado em ``n``. Uma chave de estrato ``column:q`` divide a coluna em q quantis por posto dentro de cada valor da primeira chave.

records.source: Evaluate a classifier with held-out folds and controls.

records.context: The model of ``ml_model_type`` is trained on every fold of ``ml_eval_split`` (:func:`evaluation_folds`) and predicts the held-out rows. One row per fold and one pooled row (every held-out prediction together) are reported. The controls of ``ml_eval_controls`` are reported the same way: ``majority`` always predicts the commonest label of the whole set; ``shuffled`` trains on labels permuted within each training fold, repeated ``ml_eval_shuffle_repeats`` times with seeds ``ml_eval_shuffle_seed``, ``ml_eval_shuffle_seed + 1``, ... and averaged.
records.label: spacr.ml.evaluate_classifier#1
records.source: The model of ``ml_model_type`` is trained on every fold of ``ml_eval_split`` (:func:`evaluation_folds`) and predicts the held-out rows. One row per fold and one pooled row (every held-out prediction together) are reported. The controls of ``ml_eval_controls`` are reported the same way: ``majority`` always predicts the commonest label of the whole set; ``shuffled`` trains on labels permuted within each training fold, repeated ``ml_eval_shuffle_repeats`` times with seeds ``ml_eval_shuffle_seed``, ``ml_eval_shuffle_seed + 1``, ... and averaged.
records.translation: O modelo de ``ml_model_type`` é treinado em cada partição de ``ml_eval_split`` (:func:`evaluation_folds`) e prevê as linhas retidas. São relatadas uma linha por partição e uma linha agrupada (todas as predições retidas juntas). Os controles de ``ml_eval_controls`` são relatados da mesma forma: ``majority`` sempre prevê o rótulo mais comum do conjunto inteiro; ``shuffled`` treina com rótulos permutados dentro de cada partição de treino, repetido ``ml_eval_shuffle_repeats`` vezes com as sementes ``ml_eval_shuffle_seed``, ``ml_eval_shuffle_seed + 1``, ... e com média.

records.label: spacr.ops_decode.false_call_model#1
records.source: Trained on the training fields' library calls and training-half decoys, scored on the held-out fields' library calls and evaluation-half decoys, so neither a field nor a decoy sequence is both learnt and tested. A sequence-only model (:data:`SEQUENCE_FEATURES`) measures how much of the separation comes from how the decoys were built; chance is an AUROC of 0.5. Mean absolute SHAP (Lundberg and Lee 2017) and permutation importance (average-precision drop) rank the features.
records.translation: Treinado com as chamadas da biblioteca dos campos de treino e os chamarizes da metade de treino, pontuado nas chamadas da biblioteca dos campos retidos e nos chamarizes da metade de avaliação, de modo que nem um campo nem uma sequência chamariz é ao mesmo tempo aprendido e testado. Um modelo apenas de sequência (:data:`SEQUENCE_FEATURES`) mede quanto da separação vem da forma como os chamarizes foram construídos; o acaso é uma AUROC de 0.5. O SHAP absoluto médio (Lundberg and Lee 2017) e a importância por permutação (queda da precisão média) classificam as variáveis.

records.context: Each microscope field of view is decoded permissively (:data:`QC_PERMISSIVE`) against the library and the decoys. Every read owned by a microscope field of view's nucleus becomes a row with its match, per-cycle margins and mismatches, spot features and position; every owned nucleus becomes a row labelled ``FP`` (its reads vote for a decoy), ``TP`` (a guide) or ``TN`` (no call), with the mean evidence of its supporting reads and the sequence features of its guide. Half the microscope fields of view of each laboratory microplate are held out (``test``), and the decoys are split by the md5 of their sequence into a training half and an evaluation half (``decoy_half``).
records.label: spacr.ops_decode.false_call_tables#1
records.source: Each field is decoded permissively (:data:`QC_PERMISSIVE`) against the library and the decoys. Every read owned by a field's nucleus becomes a row with its match, per-cycle margins and mismatches, spot features and position; every owned nucleus becomes a row labelled ``FP`` (its reads vote for a decoy), ``TP`` (a guide) or ``TN`` (no call), with the mean evidence of its supporting reads and the sequence features of its guide. Half the fields of each plate are held out (``test``), and the decoys are split by the md5 of their sequence into a training half and an evaluation half (``decoy_half``).
records.translation: Cada campo é decodificado de forma permissiva (:data:`QC_PERMISSIVE`) contra a biblioteca e os chamarizes. Cada leitura pertencente a um núcleo do campo torna-se uma linha com a sua correspondência, margens e descasamentos por ciclo, variáveis do ponto e posição; cada núcleo próprio torna-se uma linha rotulada ``FP`` (as suas leituras votam num chamariz), ``TP`` (uma guia) ou ``TN`` (sem chamada), com a evidência média das suas leituras de suporte e as variáveis de sequência da sua guia. Metade dos campos de cada placa é retida (``test``), e os chamarizes são divididos pelo md5 da sua sequência numa metade de treino e numa metade de avaliação (``decoy_half``).

records.context: A call to a decoy is a known false call. Out of fold, by sequencing field (five folds keyed on the field's name, so a field is never scored by a model that saw it), four models estimate P(decoy | evidence) from each call's read and pixel support (:data:`CONFIDENCE_FEATURES`): logistic regression on the features and their squares, an isotonic recalibration of that score, histogram gradient boosting, and the decoy rate of matched strata. A real call's error is then ``c * P(decoy) / P(real)``, ``c = fdr_scale / decoy_k``, and ``genotype_confidence`` is one minus it. A control fits the logistic model on decoy labels shuffled within fields; its AUC should be 0.5.
records.label: spacr.ops_decode.genotype_confidence#1
records.source: A call to a decoy is a known false call. Out of fold, by sequencing field (five folds keyed on the field's name, so a field is never scored by a model that saw it), four models estimate P(decoy | evidence) from each call's read and pixel support (:data:`CONFIDENCE_FEATURES`): logistic regression on the features and their squares, an isotonic recalibration of that score, histogram gradient boosting, and the decoy rate of matched strata. A real call's error is then ``c * P(decoy) / P(real)``, ``c = fdr_scale / decoy_k``, and ``genotype_confidence`` is one minus it. A control fits the logistic model on decoy labels shuffled within fields; its AUC should be 0.5.
records.translation: Uma chamada para um chamariz é uma chamada falsa conhecida. Fora da partição, por campo de sequenciamento (cinco partições com chave no nome do campo, de modo que um campo nunca é pontuado por um modelo que o viu), quatro modelos estimam P(decoy | evidence) a partir do suporte de leituras e pixels de cada chamada (:data:`CONFIDENCE_FEATURES`): regressão logística sobre as variáveis e os seus quadrados, uma recalibração isotônica dessa pontuação, gradient boosting por histograma e a taxa de chamarizes de estratos pareados. O erro de uma chamada real é então ``c * P(decoy) / P(real)``, ``c = fdr_scale / decoy_k``, e ``genotype_confidence`` é um menos ele. Um controle ajusta o modelo logístico com rótulos de chamariz embaralhados dentro dos campos; a sua AUC deve ser 0.5.

records.context: any of ``"stitch"``, ``"phenotype"``, ``"objects"`` and ``"decode"``, run in that order. A phase left out reads what it needs from the database, so a microplate sample position can be stitched once and decoded again. The alpha phenotype path adds ``"ph_flatfield"``, ``"ph_segment"``, ``"ph_measure"``, ``"ph_masks"``, ``"merge"`` and ``"aggregate"``, run only when named here and after those four; ``ph_flatfield`` builds the laboratory microplate's maps once, before the microplate sample positions, and ``ph_masks`` writes each cell's microscope field of view-edge flags and flat-microscope field of view gains from the saved masks. A processing session of only these needs ``dst_root`` and ``plate`` but no ``genotype_source``, takes its microplate sample positions from ``ops_phenotype``, and adds to each microplate sample position's ``ops_report.json`` rather than replacing it. ``aggregate`` pools the microplate sample positions run and writes ``ops_guides_<plate>`` and ``ops_genes_<plate>``. ``"ph_merged"`` (per microplate sample position, after ``merge``) writes each microscope field of view to ``merged/`` (:func:`_ph_merged`); ``"ph_tables"`` (after ``aggregate``) writes the standard ``measurements/measurements.db`` tables (:func:`_ph_tables`); ``"ph_crops"`` cuts raw extracted image regions of owned cells into a sharded store (:func:`_ph_crops`). ``"ph_ownership"`` (per microplate sample position, after ``ph_masks``) finds the copies of each cell across overlapping microscope fields of view (:func:`_ph_cross_field_ownership`). ``"report"``, last, writes the yield funnel and the counts against a published table to ``results/ops_report/`` (:func:`_ph_report`). With ``ops_ph_secondary_registration`` set, each microplate sample position's second phenotype acquisition is registered before its microscope fields of view are read (:func:`_ph_secondary_shifts`). The alpha ``decode_qc`` phase (items 876 and 877) fits the false-call model and the genotype confidence over the microplate sample positions decoded, writing ``results/ops_decode_qc``; it also executes after ``decode`` when ``ops_decode_qc`` or ``ops_genotype_confidence`` is on. The alpha ``compare_calls`` phase (item 878) matches spaCR's calls to other workflows' per-cell tables (``ops_compare_tables``) and writes ``results/ops_compare``; it also executes after ``decode`` when those tables are set. The alpha profile path, ``"profile"`` and ``"evaluate"``, runs alone: it turns the stored cell tables of ``ops_profile_cells`` into gene profiles and scores them against reference gene pairs (:func:`spacr.ops_tvn.run_profile_phases`).

records.source: any of ``"stitch"``, ``"phenotype"``, ``"objects"`` and ``"decode"``, run in that order. A phase left out reads what it needs from the database, so a well can be stitched once and decoded again. The alpha phenotype path adds ``"ph_flatfield"``, ``"ph_segment"``, ``"ph_measure"``, ``"ph_masks"``, ``"merge"`` and ``"aggregate"``, run only when named here and after those four; ``ph_flatfield`` builds the plate's maps once, before the wells, and ``ph_masks`` writes each cell's field-edge flags and flat-field gains from the saved masks. A run of only these needs ``dst_root`` and ``plate`` but no ``genotype_source``, takes its wells from ``ops_phenotype``, and adds to each well's ``ops_report.json`` rather than replacing it. ``aggregate`` pools the wells run and writes ``ops_guides_<plate>`` and ``ops_genes_<plate>``. ``"ph_merged"`` (per well, after ``merge``) writes each field to ``merged/`` (:func:`_ph_merged`); ``"ph_tables"`` (after ``aggregate``) writes the standard ``measurements/measurements.db`` tables (:func:`_ph_tables`); ``"ph_crops"`` cuts raw crops of owned cells into a sharded store (:func:`_ph_crops`). ``"ph_ownership"`` (per well, after ``ph_masks``) finds the copies of each cell across overlapping fields (:func:`_ph_cross_field_ownership`). ``"report"``, last, writes the yield funnel and the counts against a published table to ``results/ops_report/`` (:func:`_ph_report`). With ``ops_ph_secondary_registration`` set, each well's second phenotype acquisition is registered before its fields are read (:func:`_ph_secondary_shifts`). The alpha ``decode_qc`` phase (items 876 and 877) fits the false-call model and the genotype confidence over the wells decoded, writing ``results/ops_decode_qc``; it also runs after ``decode`` when ``ops_decode_qc`` or ``ops_genotype_confidence`` is on. The alpha ``compare_calls`` phase (item 878) matches spaCR's calls to other pipelines' per-cell tables (``ops_compare_tables``) and writes ``results/ops_compare``; it also runs after ``decode`` when those tables are set. The alpha profile path, ``"profile"`` and ``"evaluate"``, runs alone: it turns the stored cell tables of ``ops_profile_cells`` into gene profiles and scores them against reference gene pairs (:func:`spacr.ops_tvn.run_profile_phases`).
records.translation: qualquer um de ``"stitch"``, ``"phenotype"``, ``"objects"`` e ``"decode"``, executados nessa ordem. Uma fase deixada de fora lê do banco de dados o que precisa, de modo que um poço pode ser costurado uma vez e decodificado novamente. O caminho alfa de fenótipo adiciona ``"ph_flatfield"``, ``"ph_segment"``, ``"ph_measure"``, ``"ph_masks"``, ``"merge"`` e ``"aggregate"``, executados apenas quando nomeados aqui e depois dessas quatro; ``ph_flatfield`` constrói os mapas da placa uma vez, antes dos poços, e ``ph_masks`` grava os marcadores de borda de campo e os ganhos de campo plano de cada célula a partir das máscaras salvas. Uma execução apenas destas requer ``dst_root`` e ``plate``, mas nenhum ``genotype_source``, obtém os seus poços de ``ops_phenotype`` e acrescenta ao ``ops_report.json`` de cada poço em vez de substituí-lo. ``aggregate`` agrupa os poços executados e grava ``ops_guides_<plate>`` e ``ops_genes_<plate>``. ``"ph_merged"`` (por poço, após ``merge``) grava cada campo em ``merged/`` (:func:`_ph_merged`); ``"ph_tables"`` (após ``aggregate``) grava as tabelas padrão de ``measurements/measurements.db`` (:func:`_ph_tables`); ``"ph_crops"`` corta recortes brutos de células próprias num armazenamento fragmentado (:func:`_ph_crops`). ``"ph_ownership"`` (por poço, após ``ph_masks``) encontra as cópias de cada célula em campos sobrepostos (:func:`_ph_cross_field_ownership`). ``"report"``, por último, grava o funil de rendimento e as contagens contra uma tabela publicada em ``results/ops_report/`` (:func:`_ph_report`). Com ``ops_ph_secondary_registration`` definido, a segunda aquisição de fenótipo de cada poço é registrada antes de os seus campos serem lidos (:func:`_ph_secondary_shifts`). A fase alfa ``decode_qc`` (itens 876 e 877) ajusta o modelo de chamadas falsas e a confiança do genótipo sobre os poços decodificados, gravando ``results/ops_decode_qc``; também é executada após ``decode`` quando ``ops_decode_qc`` ou ``ops_genotype_confidence`` está ativado. A fase alfa ``compare_calls`` (item 878) compara as chamadas do spaCR com as tabelas por célula de outros pipelines (``ops_compare_tables``) e grava ``results/ops_compare``; também é executada após ``decode`` quando essas tabelas estão definidas. O caminho alfa de perfil, ``"profile"`` e ``"evaluate"``, é executado sozinho: transforma as tabelas de células armazenadas de ``ops_profile_cells`` em perfis de genes e os pontua contra pares de genes de referência (:func:`spacr.ops_tvn.run_profile_phases`).

records.context: A gene profile is judged by how well it finds the genes a curated resource links to it. This module reads those resources by name and version, turns each into a set of unordered gene pairs ``(a, b)`` with ``a < b``, and splits them into the halves of a selection protocol, so that a choice made on one half is reported on the other.
records.label: spacr.ops_reference#1
records.source: A gene profile is judged by how well it finds the genes a curated resource links to it. This module reads those resources by name and version, turns each into a set of unordered gene pairs ``(a, b)`` with ``a < b``, and splits them into the halves of a selection protocol, so that a choice made on one half is reported on the other.
records.translation: Um perfil de gene é julgado pelo quão bem encontra os genes que um recurso curado liga a ele. Este módulo lê esses recursos por nome e versão, transforma cada um num conjunto de pares de genes não ordenados ``(a, b)`` com ``a < b``, e os divide nas metades de um protocolo de seleção, para que uma escolha feita numa metade seja relatada na outra.

records.context: ``NAME@SELECT`` and ``NAME@REPORT`` are the two halves. records.source: ``NAME@SELECT`` and ``NAME@REPORT`` are the two halves. CORUM is split by complex: the complex names, sorted, are permuted with seed :data:`SPLIT_SEED` and alternate between the halves, and a REPORT pair that also lies in a SELECT complex is dropped. Every other reference is split by pair, on the parity of the md5 of ``"a|b"``.
records.translation: ``NAME@SELECT`` e ``NAME@REPORT`` são as duas metades. O CORUM é dividido por complexo: os nomes dos complexos, ordenados, são permutados com a semente :data:`SPLIT_SEED` e alternam entre as metades, e um par REPORT que também está num complexo SELECT é descartado. Todas as outras referências são divididas por par, pela paridade do md5 de ``"a|b"``.

records.context: Cosine similarity of the components ranks the genes. Rows, in order: the per-gene retrieval mAP of every scored reference (:func:`spacr.sp_stats.pair_map`, :func:`spacr.sp_stats.summarize_pair_map`; p values for the whole references only), each followed for CORUM, STRING >= 0.7 and BioGRID by two controls: gene labels shuffled among the targeting rows (seed 7) and fitness-matched decoy partners (seed 3); the share of control rows among the ten nearest neighbours of every targeting gene; the pair AUPRC of Brieflow's STRING pairs (30 gene resamples) and of STRING >= 0.7, and the first with shuffled labels (seed 8); held-out CORUM members, and the same with the shuffled labels; the time split.
records.label: spacr.ops_reference.evaluate_gene_profiles#1
records.source: Cosine similarity of the components ranks the genes. Rows, in order: the per-gene retrieval mAP of every scored reference (:func:`spacr.sp_stats.pair_map`, :func:`spacr.sp_stats.summarize_pair_map`; p values for the whole references only), each followed for CORUM, STRING >= 0.7 and BioGRID by two controls: gene labels shuffled among the targeting rows (seed 7) and fitness-matched decoy partners (seed 3); the share of control rows among the ten nearest neighbours of every targeting gene; the pair AUPRC of Brieflow's STRING pairs (30 gene resamples) and of STRING >= 0.7, and the first with shuffled labels (seed 8); held-out CORUM members, and the same with the shuffled labels; the time split.
records.translation: A similaridade de cosseno dos componentes classifica os genes. Linhas, em ordem: o mAP de recuperação por gene de cada referência pontuada (:func:`spacr.sp_stats.pair_map`, :func:`spacr.sp_stats.summarize_pair_map`; valores p apenas para as referências inteiras), cada um seguido, para CORUM, STRING >= 0.7 e BioGRID, por dois controles: rótulos de genes embaralhados entre as linhas direcionadas (semente 7) e parceiros chamariz pareados por aptidão (semente 3); a fração de linhas de controle entre os dez vizinhos mais próximos de cada gene direcionado; a AUPRC de pares dos pares STRING do Brieflow (30 reamostragens de genes) e de STRING >= 0.7, e a primeira com rótulos embaralhados (semente 8); membros do CORUM retidos, e o mesmo com os rótulos embaralhados; a divisão temporal.

records.context: Call bases with per-cycle axes learnt from the reads the library names.

records.context: The reads are first normalised per cycle and unmixed with brieflow's median transform. Then, for each read and cycle, the read is matched on its OTHER cycles; when exactly one guide fits, that guide names the true base at the masked cycle without looking at it. Per cycle, the median intensity of the reads labelled with each base is that base's axis; the four axes, scaled to sum to one, are inverted and every read of the cycle is unmixed with them. Labels come from the real library only, so a decoy library matched later stays an independent false-match control. This is the "S1b" calibration of the decode-yield study (item 873).
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.library_calibrated_bases#1
records.source: The reads are first normalised per cycle and unmixed with brieflow's median transform. Then, for each read and cycle, the read is matched on its OTHER cycles; when exactly one guide fits, that guide names the true base at the masked cycle without looking at it. Per cycle, the median intensity of the reads labelled with each base is that base's axis; the four axes, scaled to sum to one, are inverted and every read of the cycle is unmixed with them. Labels come from the real library only, so a decoy library matched later stays an independent false-match control. This is the "S1b" calibration of the decode-yield study (item 873).
records.translation: As leituras são primeiro normalizadas por ciclo e desmisturadas com a transformação mediana do brieflow. Depois, para cada leitura e ciclo, a leitura é comparada nos seus OUTROS ciclos; quando exatamente uma guia corresponde, essa guia identifica a base verdadeira no ciclo mascarado sem olhar para ele. Por ciclo, a intensidade mediana das leituras rotuladas com cada base é o eixo dessa base; os quatro eixos, escalados para somar um, são invertidos e todas as leituras do ciclo são desmisturadas com eles. Os rótulos vêm apenas da biblioteca real, de modo que uma biblioteca de chamarizes comparada depois continua sendo um controle independente de correspondências falsas. Esta é a calibração "S1b" do estudo de rendimento da decodificação (item 873).

records.context: For every reported panel of a figure (``plaque_area``, ``plaque_number`` or ``relative_plaque_size``), each labelling of the microplate sample positions gives the measured value of a condition as the mean over its matching microplate sample positions (:func:`condition_matches`); the measured effect is that over the reference condition's, and the reported effect is the panel's value over its reference value. The summary has, per labelling and readout (area, number, all), Spearman's rho of the log2 effects (clipped at 0.02), how many effects that differ from 1 by more than 15% point the same way, how many agree within 1.5-fold, and a permutation control: rho with the measured effects shuffled ``compare_permutations`` times (seed ``compare_seed``), its mean, its 95th percentile and a one-sided p.
records.label: spacr.plaque_papers.compare_reported#1
records.source: For every reported panel of a figure (``plaque_area``, ``plaque_number`` or ``relative_plaque_size``), each labelling of the wells gives the measured value of a condition as the mean over its matching wells (:func:`condition_matches`); the measured effect is that over the reference condition's, and the reported effect is the panel's value over its reference value. The summary has, per labelling and readout (area, number, all), Spearman's rho of the log2 effects (clipped at 0.02), how many effects that differ from 1 by more than 15% point the same way, how many agree within 1.5-fold, and a permutation control: rho with the measured effects shuffled ``compare_permutations`` times (seed ``compare_seed``), its mean, its 95th percentile and a one-sided p.
records.translation: Para cada painel relatado de uma figura (``plaque_area``, ``plaque_number`` ou ``relative_plaque_size``), cada rotulagem dos poços dá o valor medido de uma condição como a média sobre os seus poços correspondentes (:func:`condition_matches`); o efeito medido é esse valor sobre o da condição de referência, e o efeito relatado é o valor do painel sobre o seu valor de referência. O resumo contém, por rotulagem e leitura (área, número, todas), o rho de Spearman dos efeitos em log2 (cortados em 0.02), quantos efeitos que diferem de 1 em mais de 15% apontam na mesma direção, quantos concordam dentro de 1.5 vezes, e um controle de permutação: rho com os efeitos medidos embaralhados ``compare_permutations`` vezes (semente ``compare_seed``), a sua média, o seu percentil 95 e um p unilateral.

records.context: How alike two screens find the same gene pairs, against four nulls.

records.translation: O quanto duas triagens encontram os mesmos pares de genes de forma semelhante, contra quatro nulos.

records.context: Statistics, on the upper triangle of the two gene x gene similarity matrices: the Mantel statistic (Spearman, i.e. Pearson of tie-averaged ranks; Mantel 1967); the partial Mantel statistic after both rank vectors are residualised on the rank similarity of screening experiment A's fitness and of screening experiment B's profile strength; the overlap of the ``k`` nearest neighbours; and, of the pairs in the top ``top_fraction`` of both screening experiments, their number and the share that are known (STRING >= 0.7). Each is recomputed for ``n_perm`` relabellings of screening experiment A's genes: unrestricted, then within fitness deciles, within STRING-degree deciles and within strength deciles, all drawn from one ``default_rng(seed)`` in that order. ``p = (1 + draws >= observed) / (1 + draws)``.
records.label: spacr.sp_stats.cross_screen_concordance#1
records.source: Statistics, on the upper triangle of the two gene x gene similarity matrices: the Mantel statistic (Spearman, i.e. Pearson of tie-averaged ranks; Mantel 1967); the partial Mantel statistic after both rank vectors are residualised on the rank similarity of screen A's fitness and of screen B's profile strength; the overlap of the ``k`` nearest neighbours; and, of the pairs in the top ``top_fraction`` of both screens, their number and the share that are known (STRING >= 0.7). Each is recomputed for ``n_perm`` relabellings of screen A's genes: unrestricted, then within fitness deciles, within STRING-degree deciles and within strength deciles, all drawn from one ``default_rng(seed)`` in that order. ``p = (1 + draws >= observed) / (1 + draws)``.
records.translation: Estatísticas, sobre o triângulo superior das duas matrizes de similaridade gene x gene: a estatística de Mantel (Spearman, isto é, Pearson dos postos com empates pela média; Mantel 1967); a estatística de Mantel parcial depois de ambos os vetores de postos serem residualizados na similaridade de postos da aptidão da triagem A e da força dos perfis da triagem B; a sobreposição dos ``k`` vizinhos mais próximos; e, dos pares no topo ``top_fraction`` de ambas as triagens, o seu número e a fração que é conhecida (STRING >= 0.7). Cada uma é recalculada para ``n_perm`` reetiquetagens dos genes da triagem A: sem restrição, depois dentro de decis de aptidão, dentro de decis de grau STRING e dentro de decis de força, todas sorteadas de um único ``default_rng(seed)`` nessa ordem. ``p = (1 + draws >= observed) / (1 + draws)``.

records.context: Typically an optical pooled screening experiment (A) and the JUMP consensus gene profiles (B). records.context: The observed value is the mean cosine between the representations of ``gene_a`` and of the partners (absolute across an overexpression modality). Each null replaces every partner by ``n`` draws: control pseudo-profiles, random genes, genes of the same profile-strength decile and genes of the same screening experiment-A fitness decile, none of them a named gene. ``p = (1 + draws >= observed) / (1 + n)``.

records.source: The observed value is the mean cosine between the representations of ``gene_a`` and of the partners (absolute across an overexpression modality). Each null replaces every partner by ``n`` draws: control pseudo-profiles, random genes, genes of the same profile-strength decile and genes of the same screen-A fitness decile, none of them a named gene. ``p = (1 + draws >= observed) / (1 + n)``.
records.translation: O valor observado é o cosseno médio entre as representações de ``gene_a`` e dos parceiros (absoluto numa modalidade de superexpressão). Cada nulo substitui cada parceiro por ``n`` sorteios: pseudoperfis de controle, genes aleatórios, genes do mesmo decil de força de perfil e genes do mesmo decil de aptidão da triagem A, nenhum deles um gene nomeado. ``p = (1 + draws >= observed) / (1 + n)``.

records.context: Replicate retrieval, compound-gene matching and laboratory microplate effect of microplate sample position profiles.
records.label: spacr.sp_stats.profile_retrieval#0
records.source: Replicate retrieval, compound-gene matching and plate effect of well profiles.
records.translation: Recuperação de réplicas, correspondência composto-gene e efeito de placa de perfis de poços.

records.context: The procedure of the jump cpjump1 benchmark (Chandrasekaran et al. 2024). Per modality the microplate sample positions are normalised per laboratory microplate against the negative controls and feature-selected; replicate retrieval is scored on the real labels and on labels shuffled within laboratory microplates, and the laboratory microplate effect on the real and on permuted laboratory microplate labels, all from one ``default_rng(retrieval_seed)`` in that order; the laboratory microplate effect is then scored before normalisation. Compound consensus profiles are matched to the CRISPR and ORF gene consensus profiles on the features every modality kept, for all treatments and for replicable ones only, by cosine and absolute cosine, each with a shuffled-annotation control (``default_rng(retrieval_seed + 1)``).
records.label: spacr.sp_stats.profile_retrieval#1
records.source: The procedure of the JUMP CPJUMP1 benchmark (Chandrasekaran et al. 2024). Per modality the wells are normalised per plate against the negative controls and feature-selected; replicate retrieval is scored on the real labels and on labels shuffled within plates, and the plate effect on the real and on permuted plate labels, all from one ``default_rng(retrieval_seed)`` in that order; the plate effect is then scored before normalisation. Compound consensus profiles are matched to the CRISPR and ORF gene consensus profiles on the features every modality kept, for all treatments and for replicable ones only, by cosine and absolute cosine, each with a shuffled-annotation control (``default_rng(retrieval_seed + 1)``).
records.translation: O procedimento do benchmark JUMP CPJUMP1 (Chandrasekaran et al. 2024). Por modalidade, os poços são normalizados por placa em relação aos controles negativos e passam por seleção de variáveis; a recuperação de réplicas é pontuada com os rótulos reais e com rótulos embaralhados dentro das placas, e o efeito de placa com os rótulos de placa reais e permutados, tudo a partir de um único ``default_rng(retrieval_seed)`` nessa ordem; o efeito de placa é então pontuado antes da normalização. Os perfis de consenso de compostos são comparados com os perfis de consenso de genes CRISPR e ORF nas variáveis que todas as modalidades mantiveram, para todos os tratamentos e apenas para os replicáveis, por cosseno e cosseno absoluto, cada um com um controle de anotação embaralhada (``default_rng(retrieval_seed + 1)``).
